title: Verify: Sound and settings store unit tests
summary: Unit tests for sound and settings toggles
description: Write unit tests against the real store for soundEnabled and settingsOpen.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reset store, when read, then soundEnabled is true and settingsOpen is false
Given a reset store, when toggleSound is called, then only soundEnabled flips, and toggleSettings flips only settingsOpen

steps.action: Import useUiStore from '../src/store/uiStore'. Reset in beforeEach with useUiStore.setState(useUiStore.getInitialState(), true). Test defaults soundEnabled true and settingsOpen false. Test toggleSound sets soundEnabled false and leaves settingsOpen false. Test toggleSettings sets settingsOpen true and leaves soundEnabled true.
